passages.title: A Weekend at the Local Food Market
passages.text:
Last Saturday, I decided to visit the local food market in the town centre. I had heard a lot about it from my neighbours, but I had never found the time to go before. [1] As soon as I arrived, I realized I should have come much sooner. The atmosphere was incredibly lively and full of energy.

There were dozens of colourful stalls selling everything from fresh fruit to homemade cakes. [2] The smell of freshly baked bread was particularly amazing, drawing a huge crowd to one corner. I spent about an hour just walking around and looking at all the delicious options.

What I liked most was talking to the people who worked there. [3] They were happy to explain how they made their cheese or where their vegetables were grown. This made the shopping experience feel much more personal than going to a normal supermarket.

By lunchtime, I was starting to feel quite hungry because of all the wonderful smells. [4] I chose a small stall selling traditional Spanish empanadas and sat on a wooden bench to eat them. They were absolutely delicious and very filling.

Before leaving, I bought some fresh pasta and a jar of local honey to take home. [5] I am already planning my next visit and cannot wait to try some of the other stalls.

someone who sells things, especially on the street
food that makes you feel full quickly

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence to fill gap [1].
options: A) Fortunately, there were plenty of hot food stalls to choose from.
B) Each seller was proudly showing off their best products.
C) However, the prices were much higher than I had expected.
D) These will make a perfect Sunday dinner for my family.
E) It takes place every weekend, but I usually sleep late on Saturdays.
F) I had forgotten to bring enough cash with me.
G) Most of them were local farmers who had produced the food themselves.
H) My friends had promised to meet me there at noon.
questions.explanation: Option E fits perfectly because the writer mentions they 'had never found the time to go before'. Explaining that they usually sleep late on Saturdays provides the reason why they hadn't visited the Saturday market previously.
